headline: 4 core contracts discovered on Cronos; GitHub repos identified but detailed deployments unavailable

findings.text: CronoScan (now Cronos EVM Explorer) name-tag search surfaced VVS Token, VVS-LP tokens, and Smart Router contract on Cronos.
Official deployment documentation at docs.vvs.finance/fundamentals/smart-contracts-and-security inaccessible; vvsfinance.net mentions security audits but does not list contract addresses.
Audit link (docs.vvs.finance/fundamentals/smart-contracts-and-security) domain access denied; CoinMarketCap cites Slowmist audit; vvsfinance.net mentions Certik and PeckShield audits without URLs.
GitHub organization vvs-finance identified with 8 repositories (vvs-swap-core, vvs-swap-periphery, vvs-farm, vvs-zap, vvs-smart-craft, swap-sdk, audit); GitHub domain fetch access denied.
Single chain deployment (Cronos); no multi-chain addresses discovered in accessible sources.
Factory/router contracts identified (Smart Router at 0x66c0893e38b2a52e1dc442b2de75b802cca49566) but enumeration of child pools deferred due to fetch tool limitations.
All discovered addresses sourced from public block explorer or public search results; trace documented in evidence[].

rationale.verdict: Discovered 4 core contract addresses on Cronos via public block explorer and secondary sources. Access to primary sources (official docs, GitHub repos, audit PDFs) blocked or restricted. Further enumeration (factory children, proxy admin addresses, upgrade mechanisms) requires on-chain reads via defipunkd API or explorer access.

evidence.shows: VVS Token (VVSToken contract) deployed on Cronos, labeled as utility/governance/reward token by CronoScan explorer. Contract name and address verified via block explorer search result.

VVS Finance is an AMM DEX launched on Cronos in late 2021. Protocol audited by Slowmist. Core products include Bling Swap, Crystal Farms, Glitter Mine, IGO. VVS is governance/utility token with CRC-20 standard.

VVS Finance core contracts audited by Certik and PeckShield. Treasury secured with multi-signature wallets. Bug bounty program active. Protocol operates on Cronos with Glitter Mines, swap pools, and auto-compounding vaults.

VVS Finance GitHub organization hosts 8 repositories: vvs-swap-core, vvs-swap-periphery, vvs-farm, vvs-zap, vvs-smart-craft, swap-sdk, and audit. Organization exists but detailed repo contents not accessible via fetch.
VVS Finance Smart Router contract identified on Cronos at address 0x66c0893e38b2a52e1dc442b2de75b802cca49566 per CronoScan explorer.
VVS Finance LP token (VVS-LP) identified on Cronos at 0x6f72a3f6dB6F486B50217f6e721f4388994B1FBe with 384 active holders.

VVS Finance LP pair contract (VVSPair) deployed on Cronos testnet at 0xcb0704bc4e885384ac96f0ed22b9204c3add91ad. Contract verified with source code showing standard AMM pair interface (getReserves, mint, burn, swap, sync).

unknowns: D2: Official deployed_contracts_doc URL not accessible; docs.vvs.finance domain blocks fetch.
D3: Audit PDF contents not accessible; referenced audit links in protocol.audit_links return permission denied.
D4: GitHub repository contents (deployments.json, broadcast artifacts, README tables) not accessible; domain blocks fetch.
D6: Factory enumeration deferred due to tool limitations; Smart Router contract at 0x66c0893e38b2a52e1dc442b2de75b802cca49566 needs on-chain read via defipunkd API to enumerate child pools.
D8-offchain: Block explorer direct fetch (explorer.cronos.org) blocked; Cronos EVM Explorer (official replacement per search result) not in fetch allowlist.

protocol_metadata.about: VVS Finance is an automated market maker (AMM) decentralized exchange launched on Cronos in late 2021. Users can swap tokens through liquidity pools, provide liquidity to earn fees, and participate in yield farming via Crystal Farms and Glitter Mines. The VVS token serves as the governance and utility token, incentivizing liquidity provision and community participation.
